title: Rough
identify: Visible grains, bumps, or uneven microstructure.
This project splits the manual's 'Rough / Granular': rough = uneven, bumpy relief.
recognition: Irregular fine shadows and grain-like features.
source: Ceramic Attribute Taxonomy (craze documentaries.pdf) p.5 (value 'Rough / Granular')

confused_with.difference: Granular = distinct small grains like sand (the split is this project's vocabulary).
confused_with.source: general description - not defined in your reference manuals

confused_with.difference: Stony matte is a finish (low sheen, stone-like); rough is texture - keep the two attributes separate.
